items.title: Warren Buffett will go down as the 'greatest investor of all time'
items.summary: Warren Buffett stepped down as the chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B) last week, to be succeeded by his son Howard. The Glenview Trust Company CIO Bill Stone discusses Buffett's legacy as an investor before talking about Berkshire's latest stock price moves.

items.title: Meta stock jumps as Wells Fargo raises price target
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to discuss Meta (META) more than 10% intraday surge after Wells Fargo (WFC) raised its price target on the stock from $640 to $796. Meta also got a boost from its Meta Muse AI agent app climbing to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store, highlighting growing momentum around the company's AI push.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 21: Meta Surges on Excitement Over Muse Personal AI Agent
items.summary: Wells Fargo's AI-driven upgrade reinforced investor confidence as Muse AI agent gained early traction on app stores, today, Sept. 21, 2026.
